title: service_principal.state_changed (v2)
description: A service principal was disabled, re-enabled or deleted. Emitted when an administrator changes a service principal's state, when an emergency control disables or re-enables it, and when the owner-departure job disables it (realm policy machine.owner_departure=disable, reason owner_departed). Disabling or deleting revokes its automation credentials and opaque access tokens; deletion also removes its role assignments (without authorization.role.unassigned events) and is final. org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

organization_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
